title: Deep learning screens for intracranial germ cell tumors from facial photographs
summary: A deep-learning model, GVisageNet, applied to facial photographs reached AUC 0.938 on an independent validation dataset (n = 336) from four institutions, distinct from training (n = 847) and testing (n = 212) sets; a hybrid model added clinical data. The study is exploratory with small cohorts, controls and other midline tumors were selected rather than a screening population, and sensitivity and specificity are not given in the abstract.
ai_technology: GVisageNet deep-learning model on facial photographs, with a hybrid clinical-data model
organization: Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University

evidence.tested: Independent validation dataset of 336 individuals from four institutions, separate from training and testing sets.
evidence.unknown: Performance in an unselected screening population; sensitivity and specificity; privacy implications of facial data; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep-learning model on facial photographs distinguished tumor cases from normal and other midline-tumor controls.
